hook.name: SlurpV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Slurp token-launch platform that collects trading fees on buys (via BeforeSwapDelta) and sells (via AfterSwapDelta), then distributes them in-swap to the platform, token creator, and holders. It enforces exactInput-only swaps, applies anti-snipe buy caps during the launch window, and locks all liquidity so only the hook itself can modify positions.
